editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher articles, standards text, recipes, competition routines and photographs are never copied or redistributed; Swoon'd writes its own explanations, names works, people and standards as facts, and links to the original.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: She can talk about her coffee, understand why it tastes the way it does, order with confidence, ask a couple of good questions about origin or brewing, and say 'okay, I get why you love this' without faking it.

licensingConstraints.constraint: Procedural or original illustrations only (license original-swoond); no third-party photographs of farms, bags, cafes, roasters, competitors or products.
Original or synthesized steam, pour, grinder, boil and crack sounds only; no video or podcast audio.
Equipment, roaster and cafe brands, certification marks and SCA, Cup of Excellence and World Barista Championship names appear as text mentions and link-outs only, no logos.
No embedded competition or brewing video; deep-link to official pages.

Publisher articles, SCA standards text and competition routines are never copied; Swoon'd writes its own explanations and links to sources (spec sections 11 and 40). The SCA and World Coffee Research flavor wheel is cited and linked, not reproduced; Swoon'd uses an original wheel.
ICO public indicators need reuse-terms review at adapter build; ICE futures data is licensed and not assumed; European Commission pages are link-out; trade publications are link-only.

Champions, roasters and authors are named as facts only; no likeness, no fabricated quotes, no endorsement implication. Trade and certification topics are described neutrally with critiques; no brand is called ethical or unethical.

safetyConstraints: Hot water and steam cause burns: brewing water is 195 to 205 F; teach stable kettles, pouring away from the body and letting hot drinks cool before sipping. Steam wands: purge before and after, tip under the milk surface, never point at people; never remove a portafilter during extraction. For a scald, cool running water and medical care for anything serious; no other medical advice.
Milk for drinks is taught hot but drinkable (roughly 140 to 155 F / 60 to 68 C), never boiled or scalding; children's drinks cooler.
Moka pot: water only to the valve, never block the safety valve, never heat it dry or over a huge flame, open only when cool, follow the manufacturer.

Cold brew and brewed coffee: refrigerate cold brew, keep equipment clean, use within about a week (conservative guidance; verify at release), never teach long room-temperature steeps as safe; discard anything that smells or looks off.
Grinders and machines: unplug before cleaning, keep fingers away from burrs and blades, descale only with manufacturer-approved products and rinse thoroughly, never mix chemicals.
Allergens: ask first and read labels for dairy, nut, soy and oat (gluten cross-contact) milks; no medical advice; never imply an allergen is fine in small amounts.

No health claims: Swoon'd makes no benefit or risk claims about coffee or caffeine, gives no dosage or how-much-to-drink guidance, and tells anyone with a medical question (pregnancy, medication, heart conditions) to ask a health professional.
Swoon'd builds appreciation and understanding, not a substitute for barista training; never encourage the learner to fake expertise or claim credit for a brew they did not make.
